This flower is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in high alpine zones, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains almost impossible to find.

The whole flower is laid across a wound for ten minutes. It stops the bleeding without closing the flesh, so the wound still requires further treatment. This distinction helps explain why Míretári's Crown is sometimes called Bloodsuckers. Its extreme rarity makes every use exceptional.
